gold_note: Hadrosauroid cladogram. Read with the run-length line reader (identical at three settings), which lost one clade, ((Arenysaurus, Blasisaurus), Hypacrosaurus altispinus, Olorotitan), whose stem enters at H. altispinus' height; it was read from a 4x crop and inserted as sister to ((Sahaliyania, Velafrons), Magnapaulia). The root is three-way (the rest, Iguanodon, Jinzhousaurus). No clade names are printed. 61 tips, 4 polytomies (3, 3, 3, 3 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
